scale_cases.name: DSU full n and q
scale_cases.expected_reason: Chain merges, then repeated unions: state i is [n-i-1,i+2], then [1,n].

scale_cases.name: kruskal full n and m
scale_cases.expected_reason: All negative chain edges are necessary in the unique optimum; positive extras cannot improve it.

scale_cases.name: prim full n and m
scale_cases.expected_reason: All negative chain edges are necessary in the unique optimum; positive extras cannot improve it.

scale_cases.name: SCC full n and m, deep chain
scale_cases.expected_reason: All edges increase the vertex index, so each SCC is a singleton; repeated shortcut gives one extra condensation edge.

scale_cases.name: topo full n and m, deep chain
scale_cases.expected_reason: Chain forces the unique increasing order; shortcuts do not change it.

scale_cases.name: DAG full n and m, negative 64-bit distances
scale_cases.expected_reason: Negative chain is strictly cheaper than every shortcut; distance[v]=-v*10^9.

scale_cases.name: SCC full-size single component
scale_cases.expected_reason: Directed cycle visits all vertices, hence all vertices are mutually reachable.

scale_cases.name: topo full-size directed cycle
scale_cases.expected_reason: Last edge closes a cycle of length n.

scale_cases.name: DAG full-size cycle unreachable from source
scale_cases.expected_reason: Source 0 is isolated, but vertices 1..n-1 form a directed cycle.
